title: Voxel Special Edition
summary: Voxel gets its own Villager News: new shops, badges, a new player and the Ender Dragon fight on 14 November.

ticker.label: Villager News
items: I just got a cute cat
Local chicken refuses to explain itself
Creeper seen being polite, experts confused
Sheep demands to be dyed purple
Man digs straight down, has regrets
Please stop putting cake in chests
Cow stares at wall for six hours
Witnesses say the cactus started it

If you can read this, you are reading

blocks.text: Voxel just got its very own **Villager News**!
Tonight we’re covering recent events that you may not have remembered.
A lot has happened in the past week, from **multiple shop openings** to **website updates** and **an End update?!**

pages.sign: THE ENDER DRAGON FIGHT IS ANNOUNCED!

blocks.text: That’s right!
Sharpen your swords and string your bows, because we’re fighting the big bad Ender Dragon on
Saturday, November 14th at 20:00!
Be there or be square (haha, block jokes).

pages.sign: NEW SHOPS IN THE SHOPPING DISTRICT

cols.lead: In response to this exciting news,
cols.text: EchoinSilence (Lucas) has already opened a new shop: **Rocket Science**. It’s shaped like a rocket, so you can’t miss it! It sells…*\*drumroll please\**…Nether Bricks! I’m just kidding, it sells rockets. **64 rockets for 1 diamond.**

cols.lead: But that’s not the only shop opening we’ve had this week!
cols.text: **Mathi_Craft** and **EmrysPendragon** (Mathijs and Angela) have opened a new shop selling **prismarine** in multiple variants and **sea lanterns**. It’s called **Shop in a Bottle** and can be found at the start of the Shopping District.

pages.sign: NEW SHOPS IN THE SHOPPING DISTRICT

cols.lead: It seems like Mathi_Craft is making shops left and right,
cols.text: as he and **kayushka** (Kaya) are opening their **horse shop**! **The Präncing Pony**

cols.lead: What’s that? I just heard that EchoinSilence has opened another shop!
cols.text: Located next to Rocket Science, **The Cauldron** is now open for all your magical needs! Be it brewing your first potion or throwing your first pearl, they have everything you need to get started with the supernatural!

blocks.lead: With five shops under his belt, EchoinSilence joins the **Diamond Shop Badge** brigade.
blocks.text: Huh? You guys don’t know what badges are? Silly me, I should explain!
Voxel Admin Mathijs has been a very busy bee indeed this past week and has introduced a new system to the server:
Badges!
Here is a list of all the current badges and how to get your own:

pages.sign: But how do you get a badge?

blocks.text: Lay a road, build a bridge, open a shop, or complete one of the other qualifying activities, and **an admin can award you a badge** for it.
Every badge has four tiers:
with each tier including the one before it.

pages.sign: But how do you get a badge?

items.text: A pathway that connects two points along a clearly laid-out route. It should be wide enough for a horse to pass through without obstructions. The road itself must be mob-proofed using lighting or other methods.
Spans a gap from end to end and connects to roads. It must be wide enough for a horse to cross and properly lit. The bridge should also have at least some decorative/design features.
If you build, maintain, and stock a shop, you are considered a shopkeeper. Multiple people can run a single shop. The shop must be connected to the road network and located in the Shopping District.

pages.sign: But how do you get a badge?

items.text: A road in the Nether or a large, straight tunnel in the Overworld.
A chunk that looks better than it did when it was first loaded. There should be no unusual holes, and some lighting should be added where needed.

blocks.text: If you think you’re eligible for a badge, please let **Mathijs** know and he’ll award you the badge and add you to the website!
And that’s not all the server news!
Voxel can grow again, as we’ve welcomed a new member to our server:
ilyAfterLife (Thijmen)
Welcome to Voxel!
Those were our most important updates from around the server. But before we wrap things up, I just heard from **Wooly** that the weather forecast is **rain again**.
What a surprise!
Apparently, there’s more rain on the way, so don’t forget your umbrellas. Or perhaps it’s time to invest in a boat.

pages.sign: Well, that’s it for this Special Edition of Villager News!

blocks.text: Until next week!
